title: FMCW Waveform
text: Frequency-modulated continuous (FMCW) waveform source, 1 output, {Sweep direction} sets FM sweep direction; {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of the output, {Sweep time (s)} sets the duration of each linear FM, {Sweep bandwidth (Hz)} sets the fM sweep bandwidth 1e5, {Sweep interval} sets the location of FM sweep, {Output signal format}, {Number of samples in output}, {Number of sweeps in output} and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of the output waveform 1e6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sweep time (s)
params.values: Duration of each linear FM sweep 1e-4 (default)

params.name: Sweep direction
params.values: FM sweep direction Up (default) | Down | Triangle

params.name: Sweep interval
params.values: Location of FM sweep interval Positive (default) | Symmetric

params.name: Number of samples in output
params.values: Number of samples in output 100 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
